SELECT c.CAL_SN AS scheduleSn, CASE c.PRVT_YN WHEN 1 THEN '개인일정' WHEN 0 THEN '공식일정' END AS boardType, c.EVENT_NM AS title, c.EVENT_REG_DT AS regDt, u.USER_NM AS userNm, c.VIEW_CNT AS viewCnt
FROM TB_CALENDAR c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.USER_SN = u.USER_SN WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 0 -- 전체 조회 (공식, 개인 일정) AND ((c.PRVT_YN = 1 AND c.USER_SN = #{userSn}) OR (c.PRVT_YN = 0 AND c.COHORT_SN = #{cohortSn}) ) ORDER BY CAL_SN DESC -- EVENT_REG_DT ASC -- 최신글 우선 보이기 LIMIT 100 -- 일단 최대 100개만 보이게
UNION ALL
SELECT
